title: Beloved Fantasy’s Final Release Is the Biggest Hit of the Season Even Before Anime’s Return
content: Yona of the Dawn continues to grab fans’ attention even after its finale, thanks to the anime sequel confirmation and the manga’s final release. Based on an acclaimed manga series written and illustrated by Kusanagi Mizuho, the anime premiered in 2014.
author: ComicBook

title: Hana-Kimi Manga Gets New Live-Action Series, 1st Stage Play
content: Hisaya Nakajo 's classic shōjo manga Hana-Kimi ( Hana Zakari no Kimi-tachi e ) will receive both a new live-action television series and its first stage production to commemorate its 30th anniversary.
author: ANN

title: 2 Years Later, One Piece Finally Solves One of Its Biggest Mysteries About the Sun God and Luffy
content: The One Piece manga is currently deep into the action-packed climax of the Elbaph arc, delivering the necessary power upgrades to its main characters. However, amidst all the action, the series has not forgotten to resolve some of its underlying mysteries.
author: ComicBook

title: Shonen Jump’s Most Underrated Magical Action-Comedy Series Is Set to Take Over 2027
content: Shonen Jump ‘s most underrated magical action-comedy series, which debuted in 2020, is getting a special revival in 2027. Over the past few years, Shonen Jump magazine has undergone significant changes.

title: 3 Zoro Moments That Prove He’s One Piece’s Perfect First Mate
content: Any pirate across the course of history would be hard-pressed to find a better first mate than Roronoa Zoro in One Piece . The former bounty-hunting swordsman turned Straw-Hat Pirate, gives his all to his captain in every conflict and that’s what makes him the most loyal first mate in piracy.
author: ComicBook

title: Odd Taxi Manga Author Launches New Rematch With You Manga in Late November
content: Manga creator Takeichi Abaraya announced on Wednesday that they will launch a new manga titled Rematch With You in Akita Shoten 's YanChan Web manga website later this month. Abaraya previously published a dōjin version of the manga titled "My last Match With You" at the Comitia event in November 2025.
author: ANN

title: 3 Things You Need to Know Before Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2
content: It’s only been around a week since Avatar: Seven Havens wrapped up its first season, leaving several questions unanswered. The franchise returned after 12 years with a new animation series for the first time in 12 years, and the wait was worth it as the latest installment earns praise for its exceptional worldbuilding…

title: Paradox Live The Animation's Film Announces Title, 2027 Opening
content: The official website for the hip-hop-themed multimedia franchise presented the early teaser visual for its upcoming film project on Friday. The visual announced the project's Paradox Live the Movie title and 2027 opening. Studio GRAPH77 ( Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 's "Shikaku") is producing the film project.
author: ANN

title: Rainy Day Serenade Anime Reveals Key Visual, Teaser Trailer, Main Cast, April 2027 Premiere
content: Rainy Day Serenade anime revealed a key visual and teaser trailer on Friday, featuring the main cast. An April 2027 release date and the main staff were also announced. Yume Miyamoto stars in the series as Hina Katagiri alongside Takeo Otsuka who voices Takaaki Hongo.
author: Anime Corner
